caption.eng: The slope is Δs/Δt: the marked rise of 4 m in 2 s gives 2 m s⁻¹. Position is read from the vertical axis; displacement is a change in position.
caption.chn: 斜率為 Δs/Δt：圖中 2 s 內上升 4 m，故速度為 2 m s⁻¹。縱軸讀出位置，位移則是位置的變化。

caption.eng: Equal increases in velocity in equal times produce a straight v–t graph. Its slope is acceleration; its signed area gives displacement.
caption.chn: 等時間內速度增加相同，形成直線 v–t 圖。斜率表示加速度，有向面積表示位移。

caption.eng: Read slopes from displacement to velocity to acceleration. Read signed areas in reverse to find changes, adding the appropriate initial value.
caption.chn: 由位移到速度再到加速度，依次取斜率；反向取有向面積得到變化量，並須加入相應初值。

caption.eng: θ is measured from the horizontal component. The adjacent component is F cos θ and the opposite component is F sin θ.
caption.chn: θ 由水平分力方向量起；鄰邊分量為 F cos θ，對邊分量為 F sin θ。

caption.eng: The lever arm is the perpendicular distance from O to the force line, not simply OA. Here d⊥ = d sin θ.
caption.chn: 力臂是 O 至力的作用線的垂直距離，並非直接取 OA；圖中 d⊥ = d sin θ。

caption.eng: Gravity acts downward at every point, including the highest point. With negligible air resistance, horizontal velocity stays constant.
caption.chn: 每一位置都受向下重力，最高點亦然。忽略空氣阻力時，水平速度保持不變。

caption.eng: The incident ray, reflected ray and normal share one plane. Both i and r are measured from the normal, giving i = r.
caption.chn: 入射線、反射線及法線共面。i、r 都由法線量度，並滿足 i = r。

caption.eng: The original photograph shows lateral inversion. The virtual image appears behind the mirror, with the same size and perpendicular distance as the object.
caption.chn: 原照片展示橫向倒置。虛像位於鏡後，與物體大小相同，且到鏡面的垂直距離相等。

caption.eng: At the air-to-glass boundary light slows and bends towards the normal; on leaving glass it speeds up and bends away. The frequency stays unchanged.
caption.chn: 光由空氣進入玻璃時減速、偏向法線；離開玻璃時加速、偏離法線。頻率保持不變。

caption.eng: At the critical angle the refracted ray runs along the boundary. Total internal reflection occurs only for incidence greater than C from the higher-index side.
caption.chn: 入射角等於臨界角時，折射線沿介面傳播；只有由高折射率一側入射且入射角大於 C，才發生全內反射。

caption.eng: The converging lens forms a real inverted image on the translucent screen. The marked u and v are measured from the lens.
caption.chn: 會聚透鏡在半透明屏幕形成倒立實像。標示的 u、v 都由透鏡量起。

caption.eng: Diverging rays trace back to a virtual, upright, smaller image on the object side. The diagram labels distance magnitudes; signed lens calculations use v < 0.
caption.chn: 發散光線的反向延長線相交，形成物體同側的正立縮小虛像。原圖標出距離大小；帶符號的透鏡計算須取 v < 0。

caption.eng: The particle vibration arrows are parallel to wave travel. Energy propagates while particles oscillate about equilibrium positions.
caption.chn: 粒子振動箭頭與波的傳播方向平行。能量向前傳播，粒子則在平衡位置附近振動。

caption.eng: Amplitude is measured from the equilibrium line to a crest or trough; crest-to-trough distance is twice the amplitude.
caption.chn: 振幅由平衡線量至波峰或波谷；波峰至波谷的距離是振幅的兩倍。

caption.eng: One wavelength joins adjacent points in the same phase, such as successive crests. It is a distance along wave propagation.
caption.chn: 一個波長連接相鄰同相點，例如相鄰波峰；它是沿波傳播方向的距離。

caption.eng: Compare one variable at a time: greater wavelength at fixed gap, or a narrower gap at fixed wavelength, produces greater spreading.
caption.chn: 每次比較一個變量：狹縫不變時增大波長，或波長不變時縮窄狹縫，均令擴散更明顯。

caption.eng: For in-phase sources P and Q, the path difference at R is 31 − 19 = 12 cm. At wavelength 4 cm this is 3 wavelengths, giving constructive interference.
caption.chn: 對同相波源 P、Q，R 點程差為 31 − 19 = 12 cm；波長 4 cm 時相當於 3 個波長，因此相長干涉。

caption.eng: Nodes remain stationary; antinodes have maximum amplitude. Adjacent nodes are half a wavelength apart, and a node-to-adjacent-antinode gap is a quarter wavelength.
caption.chn: 波節保持靜止，波腹振幅最大。相鄰波節相距半個波長，波節與相鄰波腹相距四分之一波長。

caption.eng: a is slit separation, D is screen distance and Δy is centre-to-centre fringe spacing. The small-angle approximation is required for Δy ≈ λD/a.
caption.chn: a 是雙縫間距，D 是屏幕距離，Δy 是條紋中心間距。使用 Δy ≈ λD/a 需要小角度近似。

caption.eng: Measure θ from the central direction. d is adjacent slit spacing, not the grating width; changing D changes screen positions but not diffraction angles.
caption.chn: θ 由中央方向量起。d 是相鄰狹縫間距，並非整塊光柵的寬度；改變 D 會改變屏幕位置，但不改變衍射角。

caption.eng: The field is approximately uniform away from edges and points from the positive plate towards the negative plate. d is the perpendicular plate spacing.
caption.chn: 遠離邊緣的電場近似均勻，由正板指向負板。d 是兩板的垂直間距。

caption.eng: The output terminals are across R₁. This is why R₁, rather than R₂, appears in the numerator of the displayed divider formula.
caption.chn: 輸出端接在 R₁ 兩端，因此所示分壓公式的分子是 R₁。

caption.eng: Right thumb follows conventional current; curled fingers follow the circular magnetic field. Reverse the current and the field direction reverses.
caption.chn: 右手拇指沿傳統電流，其餘四指彎曲方向表示環形磁場；電流反向，磁場方向亦反向。

caption.eng: The coil field is perpendicular to the coil plane at its centre. Field lines form closed loops around the current.
caption.chn: 線圈中心的磁場垂直於線圈平面，磁力線繞電流形成閉合曲線。

caption.eng: Inside the long solenoid the nearly parallel, evenly spaced field lines indicate an approximately uniform field. Outside, they run from N towards S.
caption.chn: 長螺線管內，近似平行且均勻排列的磁力線表示近似均勻磁場；管外磁力線由 N 指向 S。

caption.eng: Curl the fingers along conventional current around the turns. The thumb points along the internal magnetic field and towards the north end.
caption.chn: 四指沿每匝的傳統電流方向彎曲，拇指指出管內磁場方向及北極端。

caption.eng: First finger B, second finger I and thumb F are mutually perpendicular. I means conventional current; a negative moving charge reverses the force obtained from its velocity.
caption.chn: 食指 B、中指 I、拇指 F 互相垂直。I 是傳統電流；以負電荷速度判斷時，受力方向須反轉。

caption.eng: Use the field of one wire to find the force on the other. Opposite currents repel (top); currents in the same direction attract (bottom).
caption.chn: 先求一條導線產生的磁場，再判斷另一條所受的力。上排反向電流相斥，下排同向電流相吸。

caption.eng: θ is between B and the area normal. Only B cos θ passes normally through the area; a field parallel to the surface gives zero flux.
caption.chn: θ 是 B 與面積法線之間的角。只有 B cos θ 垂直穿過面積；磁場平行表面時磁通量為零。

caption.eng: Each of N turns links flux Φ, so total flux linkage is NΦ. A change in this total determines the induced e.m.f.
caption.chn: N 匝每匝鏈結磁通量 Φ，總磁通鏈為 NΦ。感生電動勢取決於此總量的變化率。

caption.eng: Step-up: more secondary turns and a higher secondary voltage. Step-down: fewer secondary turns and a lower voltage; ideal power remains conserved.
caption.chn: 升壓：副線圈匝數較多，電壓較高。降壓：副線圈匝數較少，電壓較低；理想變壓器仍遵守功率守恆。

caption.eng: Protons and neutrons form the nucleus; electrons occupy the surrounding region. The diagram is schematic and not to scale.
caption.chn: 質子和中子組成原子核，電子位於核外區域。此圖是示意圖，並非按比例繪製。

caption.eng: The Sun lies at one focus F. The other focus is empty; the orbit is not centred on the Sun.
caption.chn: 太陽位於焦點 F，另一焦點沒有天體；軌道並非以太陽為幾何中心。

caption.eng: The one-AU baseline subtends the annual parallax angle. The full apparent shift over six months is twice that angle.
caption.chn: 1 AU 基線對應周年視差角；相隔半年的視位置總角位移是該角的兩倍。

caption.eng: A hotter blackbody has greater total emission and a shorter peak wavelength. The peak position is not itself the perceived colour of the complete spectrum.
caption.chn: 黑體越熱，總輻射越強，峰值波長越短。整個光譜的視覺顏色並非只由峰值波長決定。

caption.eng: The heat delivered outside equals heat removed from the cold space plus electrical work input: Q_H = Q_C + W. The original teacher annotations are retained at the left.
caption.chn: 送往外界的熱量等於從冷空間吸走的熱量，加上輸入電功：Q_H = Q_C + W。左側保留原書教師旁註。

caption.eng: As quantum number n increases, bound-state energy approaches zero from below and orbit radius increases. The energy spacing becomes smaller.
caption.chn: 量子數 n 增加時，束縛態能量由負值趨近零，軌道半徑增大，而能級間距縮小。

caption.eng: Compare clearly resolved, just resolved and unresolved pairs. At the Rayleigh limit, one central maximum falls on the first minimum of the other pattern.
caption.chn: 依次比較清楚分辨、剛好分辨及無法分辨。瑞利極限時，一個中央極大與另一圖形的第一極小重合。

caption.eng: The cornea and lens refract light; accommodation changes the lens shape while the retina distance remains almost fixed.
caption.chn: 角膜與晶狀體使光折射；視覺調節改變晶狀體形狀，而視網膜距離近似固定。

caption.eng: The converging spectacle lens produces a virtual image at the unaided near point. The eye then forms a real image on the retina; these are two different images.
caption.chn: 會聚眼鏡先在裸眼近點形成虛像，再由眼睛在視網膜形成實像；這是兩個不同的成像過程。

caption.eng: An incoherent fibre bundle scrambles relative positions and carries illumination. Image transmission requires a coherent bundle with positions preserved.
caption.chn: 不相干光纖束打亂相對位置，可用於照明；傳像須用保持相對位置的相干光纖束。

caption.eng: Lever action increases force and the smaller oval-window area further increases pressure. The illustrated factors multiply to give the pressure gain.
caption.chn: 槓桿作用增大作用力，卵圓窗較小的面積進一步增大壓強；圖示兩個倍率相乘得到壓強增益。

caption.eng: Incident intensity divides into reflected and transmitted parts. A larger impedance mismatch gives a larger reflected fraction at normal incidence.
caption.chn: 入射聲強分為反射與透射部分；垂直入射時，兩介質聲阻抗差異越大，反射比例越高。

caption.eng: The back-surface echo travels an extra outward and return distance of 2Δd. Therefore the time difference gives Δd = cΔt/2.
caption.chn: 背面回波多走的去回程為 2Δd，因此由回波時間差得到 Δd = cΔt/2。

caption.eng: Intensity decreases exponentially with thickness. Equal additional thicknesses reduce the intensity by equal fractions, not equal absolute amounts.
caption.chn: 強度隨厚度呈指數減少。相同新增厚度令強度減少相同比例，並非相同絕對量。

caption.eng: Each beam records attenuation summed along its path. Measurements at several angles constrain the individual regions A–D used to reconstruct the slice.
caption.chn: 每束射線記錄沿路徑的總衰減；多角度量度可求出 A–D 各區域的衰減，用以重建切面。
